newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Pirelli has 98.7 pct of Pir Tyre.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli has 98.7 pct of Pir Tyre.

text.p: Amsterdam-listed Pirelli Tyre Holding NV said on Thursday Italy's Pirelli SpA now holds 98.7 percent of Pirelli Tyre's ordinary shares.
Pirelli SpA -- which already had a majority stake in Pirelli Tyre -- launched a bid of 19.50 guilders per share for the remaining outstanding shares in January.
On March 21, payment in cash for the tendered shares and warrants shall be made.
Holders of shares and warrants of Pirelli Tyre who have not tendered can do so until March 15, on the terms and conditions of the public bid made in January.
"Termination of the listing of Pirelli Tyre Holding NV on the AEX (Amsterdam) Stock Exchange is expected to be sought by the end of June," Pirelli said in a statement.
